description: Report the fill you got when you executed a forge_signal_plan on your own account (POST /forge/signals/{signal_id}/fills). A plain write: no charge. Requires signal_id, account_address (which of your active mirrors executed it), filled_at (ISO-8601, not in the future), price, qty and side (buy/sell, must match the signal). venue_order_id is optional. The record shows in GET /forge/vaults/{id}/mirrors/me as source self_report. A signal that a later one superseded is refused. Needs your agent key (X-NW-User-Key).

venue_order_id.description: Optional: the venue's own order or fill id

name: forge_signal_fill
title: Report a mirrored fill
